topic: The man who woke up at his own funeral — and no one believed him
hook: He woke up at his own funeral. Nobody believed him.
script: He woke up at his own funeral. Nobody believed him. In 1995, a South African man named Sipho William Mdletshe was declared dead after a car accident. He was placed in a metal box for two days. He woke screaming. Workers heard him and released him. When he returned home, his fiancée refused to believe he was real. She thought he was a zombie. She left him. He survived death and lost everything. Follow for real cases stranger than fiction.
